FIELDS.NAME: Summit Home Builders
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Lead Inspector, Summit Home Builders, 123-456-7890
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Summit Home Builders, we specialize in residential construction, focusing on new home builds and interior renovations for single-family homes. Our operations emphasize quality craftsmanship and client satisfaction, ensuring that every project meets our high standards. We engage only licensed subcontractors for specialized trades such as electrical, plumbing, and HVAC work, which helps to mitigate liability risks. Our dedicated team operates within a strict safety framework, adhering to OSHA guidelines and maintaining comprehensive safety documentation. With a strong commitment to risk management, we aim for a clean operational history, free from any claims or losses over the past five years. We do not undertake commercial projects exceeding $500,000, and we avoid high-risk activities such as roofing and excavation, ensuring that our focus remains on the core residential services we deliver with integrity and professionalism.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities, including work in New York City, Nassau, Suffolk, or Westchester counties, as well as heavy construction activities like bridge construction, dredging, drilling, and tunneling. Furthermore, we confirm that we do not participate in ship repair, marine construction, waterproofing, or tree service/removal, and we do not provide services as roofers, handypersons, excavators, or tree removal/stump grinding providers.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Home Renovation Solutions, LLC, specializing in kitchen and bath remodels for residential properties.
FIELDS.PREVIOUS CARRIER: State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On May 10, 2022, we experienced a water damage incident at a residential project site due to a burst pipe, resulting in a loss of $15,000. The claim was submitted to the insurance company and is currently in the status of "pending review," awaiting final assessment. No prior claims have been reported.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sat 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Chain link fencing and a nightly security watchman for job site protection.
